description: Double-check one IP before any decision on it: its traffic at the alert moment (±15 min) and over the last 3 days across all of the org's apps (requests per day, paths, status mix, attack payloads, scanner paths), sign-in events, trusted / allowlist / protected / verified-bot status, earlier decisions by people, and reputation. Returns verdict (malicious, suspicious, benign, insufficient_data, never_block), riskScore, blockAllowed, the signals behind them and a verificationId valid 30 minutes, which the agent block, close and false-positive tools require.

at.description: Optional ISO time of the alert when there is no notification.

notificationId.description: Notification id of the Requires Human row or review run the IP comes from (sets the alert moment).

name: securenow_agent_verify_ip
title: Verify IP Before Acting
